rounds.prompt_ar: نختار صورة تمشيط الشعر. دي واحدة من عادات العناية بنفسنا.
rounds.success_ar: لقينا تمشيط الشعر. وغسل الوش كمان عادة مفيدة.
rounds.retry_ar: الاتنين عادات عناية. ندور هنا على المشط والشعر.

rounds.prompt_ar: نختار صورة الفاكهة في نشاط الأكل الصحي.
rounds.success_ar: دي الفاكهة. بنختار أكل متنوع وبنطلب مساعدة الكبار.

rounds.prompt_ar: فين صورة الطفل اللي مبسوط؟ نحكي مع شخص كبير عن إحساسه.

rounds.retry_ar: نبص على تعبير وش الطفل ونجرب تاني.

rounds.prompt_ar: فين صورة الطفل اللي زعلان؟ لو إحنا زعلانين نقدر نحكي لحد بنثق فيه.
rounds.success_ar: لقينا صورة الطفل الزعلان. الزعل إحساس عادي ونقدر نطلب مساعدة.
rounds.retry_ar: نتفرّج على تعبير الوش مع شخص كبير.

activities.adaptation_note: Original cumulative audio-picture review of known feelings, fruit and hair vocabulary. Not a new official worksheet or an assessment of a child's own feelings.
activities.parent_guide: نراجع كلمات من اللي اتعلّمناها: مبسوط، زعلان، فاكهة، وشعر. نسمع معنى الصورة بالعربي وبعده الكلمة بالإنجليزي. وتدريب اسمع واختار اللي بعده بيستخدم نفس الصور والأصوات، من غير درجات أو وقت.

letters.trace_path_upper: Start at the top and go straight down. Lift. Go across the top, left to right.
letters.trace_path_lower: Stroke 1: go straight down and curve to the right at the bottom (a small tail). Stroke 2: go across the stem, left to right.

letters.trace_path_upper: Book model has bars. Go across the top bar, left to right. Go straight down the middle. Go across the bottom bar, left to right.
letters.trace_path_lower: Book model: a round dot on top and a straight stem below. Trace the dot, then the straight stem down.

letters.trace_path_upper: Start at the top right, curve left and around, then curve right and down like a snake.
Slant down to the left. Lift. Slant down to the right from the top. Lift. Go across the middle.
letters.trace_path_lower: Stroke 1: a short line straight down on the right. Stroke 2: go round the circle, counter-clockwise.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Slant down from the top-left to the bottom-right. Lift. Go straight up on the right.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go straight down. Go back up, then over the hump and down.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Start at the top, bump round to the middle.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go straight down, below the line. Go back up, bump round to the middle.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down on the left. Lift. Straight down on the right. Lift. Go across the middle.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go straight down tall. Go back up, then over the hump and down.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Start at the top, big curve round to the bottom.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go round the circle, counter-clockwise. Then a tall line straight down on the right.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Start at the top, bump round to the middle. Then slant down to the right.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go straight down. Go back up, then a little hook over.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Go across the top. Go across the middle. Go across the bottom.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go across the middle, then curve up and around, finish at the bottom right.

letters.trace_path_upper: Start at the top right, curve round to the left and down, finish at the bottom right. Keep it open.
letters.trace_path_lower: Same open curve as C, small.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Slant in from the top right to the middle. Then slant out to the bottom right.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go straight down tall. Lift. Slant in from the right to the middle, then slant out to the bottom right.

letters.trace_path_upper: Go straight down. Lift. Slant down to the middle. Slant up to the top right. Go straight down.
letters.trace_path_lower: Go straight down. Go back up, over a hump and down. Back up, over a second hump and down.
